Smt Gutta Venkata Ramadevi vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
on 16 May, 2024
 Honourable Sri Justice V.Srinivas
 Writ Petition No.11942 of 2024
Order:

entities.text: Gutta Venkata Ramadevi vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, seeking the following relief:-
"...to issue a Writ or Order or Direction more particularly in the Nature of a Writ of Mandamus declaring the proposed action of the Respondents in Constructing a Pillars in front of the Petitioner's House as well as abutting the petitioner's house and passing through the Petitioner's Residential House bearing D.No. 1/619 Bandar Road, Revenue Ward No.1, Gudivada in an extent of 280 Sq Yds in Survey No.289/2 of Gudivada, Krishna District: by demolition of the petitioner's house in connection with Laying a Road NH 165 (Gudivada-Gangadharapuram Section) even though the petitioner land is not notified either Under the Notification issued under Section 3-A- or made any Publication under Section 3D of the National Highways Act, 1956 without following the Procedure of Law and even without awarded any Compensation in the name of Petitioner all are illegal, Unlawful, Violation of Article 14,19,21,300-A- of the Constitution of India, Violation of Principles of Natural Justice Consequently to direct the Respondents not to Construct any Pillar or bridge by abutting the petitioner's house or in front of the Petitioner's house by demolition of the Petitioner's house bearing D.No.1/619 Bandar Road, Revenue Ward No.1,
Gudivada in an extent of 280 Sq Yds in Survey No.289/2 of Gudivada, Krishna District without following the Procedure of Law or Payment of Compensation as per the Market Value to the Petitioner pending disposal of the main Writ Petition in the interest of the justice, and to pass such other order or orders as this Hon'ble Court may deems fit just and proper in the circumstances of the case and pass..."

2. Heard Sri R.Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioner, Smt.T.Lakshmi Padmaja, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.1, 2 and 4, Sri Lakaraju Padma Rao, learned Standing Counsel appearing for respondent Nos.5 to 7 and Sri M.Gnaneswara Rao, learned Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings appearing for respondent No.8.
3.

Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos1, 2 and 4,
submits that they have not acquired any land of the petitioner in Survey No.289/2 of Gudivada,
Krishna District, and they have only acquired the land in R.S.Nos.4-1, 27-1A of Gudivada town of Gudivada Mandal.
If the respondent authorities require the subject land for construction, they will proceed in accordance with law.

sentences.text: 4. Learned Standing Counsel appearing for respondent Nos.5 to 7 submits that they are unnecessarily shown as parties to this writ petition.
5. Learned Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings appearing for respondent No.8 submits that the petitioner's house does not fall within pier location of construction area.
The Road and Buildings Department has not taken up any construction activity in the subject land.

He also submits that if the Road and Buildings Department requires any construction activity in the subject property, they will proceed in accordance with law, by paying compensation to the petitioner.

6. Having regard to the above facts and circumstances of the case and considering the submissions that as no construction activity is taken place in the subject land of the petitioner, the cause in this Writ Petition does not survive for adjudication.
Hence, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of this Writ Petition.
7. Accordingly, this Writ Petition is disposed directing the official respondents that if they require the subject land of the petitioner, they have to proceed in accordance with law.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

Note:
Registry is directed to issue C.C. in two (02) days.
